title: callback.requested
description: Somebody asked to be called back: a phone caller the overflow agent answered, a web visitor who left a number at the widget, or a caller who asked the agent for one (call.callback). Written into the agent's own log; the tenant's app reads it and places the call.

CallbackRequested.description: Somebody asked to be called back: a phone caller the overflow agent answered, a web visitor who left a number at the widget, or a caller who asked the agent for one (call.callback). Written into the agent's own log; the tenant's app reads it and places the call.

number.description: The number to call back, E.164.

via.description: Who took the request: the overflow agent that answered a phone call the fleet could not, the widget, before any room was made, or the agent itself, on a call.

call.description: The call the request was made on, when there was one. Null for a widget visitor who never had a room.

when.description: When the caller asked to be called, when the agent said.

note.description: What the call back is about, when the agent said.

contact.description: Who asked, when the app said.
